## Description

Update CLAUDE.md Architecture section and Quick Reference table, and KNOWN-ISSUES.md, to document the new UI/UX reference library infrastructure.

## testing_mode
GREEN

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] CLAUDE.md Architecture section includes one-liner references to: plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/ (corpus location), plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.sh (retrieval script), dso ref-query shim, check-corpus-schema.sh pre-commit hook, docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml, and a note that plugins/dso/data/** requires boundary allowlist entry maintenance
- [ ] CLAUDE.md Quick Reference table includes a row for 'dso ref-query' with flags: --top-n, --tier, --session-hash
- [ ] KNOWN-ISSUES.md has an entry: after adding new corpus domain files, _index.yaml must be manually updated and committed (prevents silent manifest drift)
- [ ] All changes follow .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md formatting conventions
- [ ] CLAUDE.md additions are one-line pointers per invariant:claude-md-purpose (no verbose inline expansion)

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: CLAUDE.md Architecture section references all corpus infrastructure components
- DD2: CLAUDE.md Quick Reference table includes dso ref-query entry with flags
- DD3: KNOWN-ISSUES.md has corpus maintenance entry

## Files to Modify
- CLAUDE.md [UPDATE]
- .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md [UPDATE]
